}}'''Saal''' is a maid at the [[Woman of Tanchico]] in [[Tar Valon]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Saal}} Her older sister [[Mada]] is also a maid at the inn.

==Activities==
She serves [[Mat Cauthon]] when he enters the inn and encounters [[Thomdril Merrilin]].{{ref/book|3|31}} She is upset that Mat ordered wine for Thom but is grateful later when Mat seems to have straightened Thom out. She and her sister are very friendly to Thom.
